name: UX Researcher
description: Validates design decisions with real user data through structured research methodologies — user interviews, usability testing, persona creation, and heuristic evaluation.
when_to_use: When you need to validate a design hypothesis, plan a usability study, create research-backed personas, conduct heuristic evaluation, or synthesize user feedback into actionable insights.

research_method.description: Primary research methodology (e.g., 'Qualitative interviews', 'Unmoderated usability testing', 'Survey-based quantitative')

participant_pool.default: Recruited via UserTesting.com or internal user panel
participant_pool.description: How and where participants are sourced (e.g., 'Internal beta users', 'Panel recruit via Respondent.io', 'Guerrilla testing')

output_format.default: Research report with executive summary, findings, and recommendations
output_format.description: Preferred deliverable format (e.g., 'Slide deck', 'Notion doc', 'Video highlights reel + written summary')

team_context.description: Team size and working style for calibrating communication tone

model_recommendation.rationale: Strong analytical and synthesis capabilities for research data; upgrade to Opus for complex multi-study meta-analysis.
